title: Ray Fowler's Sylvania contractors report UFOs to Condon investigator

tellings.quote: Uh Ray Fowler was um a manager working with under Sylvania Corporation.

plain: In 1967, workers from the electronics company Sylvania who were doing contract work at Malmstrom Air Force Base, a nuclear missile base in Montana, reported UFOs to an investigator named Roy Craig from the Condon study, a University of Colorado inquiry into UFOs paid for by the Air Force. Robert Salas, a former Air Force missile officer, relays this from what he learned of Ray Fowler, whom he describes as "a manager working with under Sylvania Corporation." Salas tells it because, if true, it means civilian contractors also saw objects around the missile sites and told an official investigator.
